01 / ABOUT+

Curious about the patterns.
Just as curious about the people.

My path into data started with an interest in human behaviour. Studying psychology, computer science, and education taught me to look at a problem from more than one perspective — and to ask what the numbers mean in context.

Now, I’m pursuing a Master of Information in Human-Centred Data Science at the University of Toronto. I’m interested in using analysis to understand behaviour, uncover useful patterns, and communicate findings that people can act on.
